entities.summary: Allen Murphy is an American former professional basketball player. Born in Birmingham, Alabama, Murphy was a 6 ft 4½ in 190 lb (86 kg) guard and at played shooting guard for the Louisville Cardinals, for whom he was part of their 1975 Final Four team. He had a short stint with the NBA's Los Angeles Lakers.
